name: Court Bard
summary: A polished courtier who weaponizes etiquette, ridicule, scandal, and a commanding public presence.

features.name: Satire -1
features.summary: Penalize nearby enemies' weapon attacks, weapon damage, and saves against fear and charm while they hear your performance.
features.scaling: -1; worsens at 5th level and every 6 levels thereafter

features.name: Mockery -2
features.summary: Give one creature that hears you a penalty on Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks.

features.name: Glorious Epic
features.summary: Make nearby enemies that fail a Will save flat-footed while they hear your captivating epic.

features.name: Scandal
features.summary: Incite nearby enemies that fail a Will save to attack one another as a song of discord.

features.name: Heraldic Expertise
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Diplomacy and Knowledge (history, local, and nobility), with daily rerolls of those checks.
features.scaling: half Bard level; 1 reroll/day plus 1 every 5 levels

features.name: Wide Audience
features.summary: Use a 60-foot cone instead of a 30-foot radius for area performances and expand performance areas or target counts every five levels.
features.scaling: +10-foot radius, +20-foot cone, or +1 target per 5 levels after 5th
